description: Estimate the Miles & More award miles, Points, Qualifying Points and HON Circle Points for a Lufthansa, SWISS, Austrian or Brussels Airlines ticket. Award miles = fare in EUR x 4 (x 6 with Frequent Traveller, Senator or HON Circle status), at least 125 per flight. Points per flight by cabin: continental 20/20/40/40, intercontinental 60/80/200/400 (Economy/Premium Economy/Business/First). Give the one-way flights as segs, one entry per flight with the ISO country codes of its two airports (both on one continent = continental; Algeria, Egypt, Libya, Morocco and Tunisia count as Europe; for Turkey, Russia and other countries on two continents set kind to C or I), or give only the numbers of continental (cont) and intercontinental (icf) flights. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Give the price in EUR, not US dollars. Unofficial.

cabin.description: Cabin. Y = Economy; W = Premium Economy; C = Business; F = First.

cont.description: Continental flights. One way. Filled in from the airports above; you can also type it. Both airports on the same continent, including domestic flights.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Lufthansa's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The programs follow the airline in op (LH: united, aeroplan; LX: united, aeroplan; OS: united, aeroplan; SN: united, aeroplan). Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

hp.description: HON Circle Points you have this year (optional). Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

icf.description: Intercontinental flights. One way. Airports on two different continents.

op.description: Operated by. LH = Lufthansa; LX = SWISS; OS = Austrian; SN = Brussels. All four earn the same with Miles & More.

price.description: Fare in euros in EUR. In euros (EUR), for the whole ticket: the base fare plus the surcharges the airline adds, without government taxes and airport charges. Miles & More converts a fare in another currency to euros itself. This method is for tickets from a Lufthansa Group airline (numbers starting 220, 724, 257, 082 or 101, or Eurowings). Required unless creditTo is given.

pts.description: Points you have this year (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next tier.

qp.description: Qualifying Points you have this year (optional).

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; optional kind, C (continental) or I (intercontinental), which overrides the country table; optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

kind.description: C = continental, I = intercontinental. Overrides the country table; needed for countries on two continents such as TR or RU.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your Miles & More status. MM = Member (no status); FT = Frequent Traveller; SE = Senator; HC = HON Circle. Frequent Traveller, Senator and HON Circle earn 6 award miles per euro instead of 4.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip (same flights back). Round trip counts the same flights back. The fare above is for the whole ticket either way.

title: Lufthansa Group Miles & More Calculator
